microtenantId.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

weight.description: The weight of the load balancing configuration. Weights with a lower value indicate that a lesser number of requests are served by the App Connectors linked to the server group. Weights with a higher value than other server groups indicate that the App Connectors linked to the server group serve a greater number of requests. Server groups with weights set to 0 do not route requests.

brokerId.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA Public Service Edge.

creationTime.description: The time the App Connector version is created.

ctrlChannelStatus.description: The status of the control channel.

currentVersion.description: The current version of the App Connector.

disableAutoUpdate.description: Indicates if automatic updates are disabled (true) or not (false).

expectedVersion.description: The expected version of the App Connector.

id.description: The unique identifier of the App Connector version.

lastBrokerConnectTime.description: The time the ZPA Public Service Edge last connected.

lastBrokerDisconnectTime.description: The time the ZPA Public Service Edge last disconnected.

lastUpgradedTime.description: The time the App Connector last upgraded.

latitude.description: The latitude of the App Connector.

loneWarrior.description: When true, indicates to the App Connector that it's the sole remaining App Connector in a group. If true, the App Connector in the group attempts to run up until the last moment rather than gracefully shedding users.

longitude.description: The longitude of the App Connector.

modifiedBy.description: The unique identifier of the tenant who modified the App Connector version.

modifiedTime.description: The time the App Connector version is modified.

mtunnelId.description: The unique identifier of the Microtunnel (M-Tunnel) communication channel between Zscaler Client Connector and the ZPA Private Service Edge.

platform.description: The host OS the App Connector is deployed on.

platformDetail.description: The platform the App Connector is deployed on.

previousVersion.description: The previous version of the App Connector.

privateIp.description: The private IP address of the App Connector.

publicIp.description: The public IP address of the App Connector.

restartTimeInSec.description: The time in seconds the App Connector restarted.

runtimeOS.description: The run time OS on which the App Connector is running.

sargeVersion.description: The Manager software version App Connector. To learn more, see Understanding the Manager Software.

systemStartTime.description: The start time for the system of the App Connector.

upgradeAttempt.description: The number of attempts the App Connector takes to upgrade. This field is read only and is ignored in PUT and POST requests.

upgradeNowOnce.description: Whether or not the App Connector is upgraded to a new version only once. If set to true, the App Connector upgrades to the new version and then resets this field to false.

If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

policyType.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

capabilities.description:
The type of capabilities for the privileged portals policy. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

policyType.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

capabilities.description:
The type of capabilities for the privileged portals policy. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

policyType.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

capabilities.description:
The type of capabilities for the privileged portals policy. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

policyType.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

The microtenantId can be obtained from the API keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

policyType.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

capabilities.description:
The type of capabilities for the privileged portals policy. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

policyType.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

capabilities.description:
The type of capabilities for the privileged portals policy. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

The microtenantId can be obtained from the API keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

policyType.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.

  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

policyType.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

policyType.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy

capabilities.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.
